'''Lengilu''' is a nearly extinct language of Indonesian Borneo. At present,{{As of?|date=December 2022}} there are only four native speakers of Lengilu.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://idreferensi.com/artikel/123231/bahasa-lengilu|title=Bahasa Lengilu|last=IDreferensi.com|website=IDreferensi.com|language=id|access-date=2019-06-26|archive-date=2019-06-26|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190626133645/https://idreferensi.com/artikel/123231/bahasa-lengilu|url-status=live}}</ref>
